name: Amamiya Hikari
source:
Kirara’s classmate and class representative: a talented, attractive honor student.

Excellent in both studies and sports, sociable, well-liked, and seemingly without a single flaw, the center of the class.
She looks neat and elegant, with an outstanding figure. Popular with the boys and equally kind to everyone, she seems like a goddess to the withdrawn Kirara.
That wholesome impression comes first, but in reality she is a sex-obsessed slut.

When she goes into “slut mode” she often transforms into a flashy gyaru; she is the one who pulled Kirara into that world after they ran into each other.

Source:  [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/bitchswitch.html]Official Webiste[/url]
